Closing in favour of a replacement PR on the same branch, opened through `pr-opener.yml` so it carries the actual MI-171 report.

This PR was opened by `claude-pr-automerge` because my `create_pull_request` returned a write-scope 403 twice (`pull_request_read` on #11271 succeeded throughout, so this is the write-scope shape, not the transient MCP drop). That workflow sets `title` to the head-commit subject and a hardcoded boilerplate body — so this PR was titled *"MI-171: unwrap two backlog ids so they resolve"*, which is the subject of a small follow-up commit and a real misrepresentation of the change: the branch is a measurement answering `BL-20260907-ALPACA-CLOSE-OF-ONE-TRADE-LIQUIDATES-ITS-SIBLINGS`'s "We did not look."

`update_pull_request` 403s for me too, so the title and body cannot be edited in place. No commit, file or check is being discarded — the replacement PR is the SAME branch at the SAME head. Only the title and body change.

Nobody needs to act on this close.
